subject: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR)
source_note: Compiled from CAT 2025 (conducted 30 Nov 2025 by IIM Kozhikode) slot-wise analyses and multi-year coaching-tracker trend data, cross-checked Sep 2026. CAT has no officially published syllabus document; topic lists here are reverse-engineered from repeated set-types across recent years' papers. Since roughly 2021, DILR is presented as caselets/sets (not separate DI and LR question blocks) - each set bundles a data scenario with ~4-6 questions, mixing MCQ and TITA within the same set. Always cross-check against the current-year CAT official notification/mock test.
exam_pattern_note: CAT DILR: 22 questions, 40-minute fixed time limit, no sectional choice. Typically presented as 4 sets of ~5-6 questions each. Each set is usually either data-interpretation-flavoured (tables, bar/line graphs, pie charts) or logical-reasoning-flavoured (arrangements, puzzles, games & tournaments, Venn diagrams, binary/selection logic), though recent years increasingly blend both within a single set.
